sources.articleTitle: Ruto, Sifuna tie in TIFA presidential popularity poll
15pc of Kenyans undecided on preferred 2027 presidential winner – TIFA
Sifuna more popular than Gachagua among Mt Kenya, DCP supporters – TIFA poll

headline: TIFA Polls Indicate Emerging Trends Ahead Of 2027 Kenya Elections
seoTitle: TIFA Presidential Popularity Polls Ahead of 2027 Election
metaDescription: A recent TIFA poll reveals shifting voter preferences for the 2027 presidential race, highlighting a tie between Ruto and Sifuna among voters.
aiSummaryBullets: A TIFA poll shows a statistical tie in presidential popularity between President Ruto and Sifuna.
Among supporters of the DCP, 34 percent favor Sifuna compared to 25 percent who support Gachagua.
The survey indicates that 15 percent of Kenyan voters remain undecided regarding their preferred candidate for the 2027 general election.
aiContextParagraph: The political landscape in Kenya is being evaluated ahead of the 2027 general election through recent survey data released by TIFA. Findings show that President William Ruto and Sifuna currently share comparable levels of popularity, reflecting a competitive atmosphere among potential candidates. Within the DCP base specifically, Sifuna has garnered higher preference than Gachagua, according to the poll results. Furthermore, the report identifies Kithure Kindiki as the preferred choice for running mate alongside President Ruto. Analysts note that a significant portion of the electorate, estimated at 15 percent, has not yet declared a preference, suggesting that the views of these undecided voters will remain a critical factor in the evolving political climate as the election period approaches. These insights provide a snapshot of current public sentiment regarding the top leadership contenders as parties begin to assess their standing with the Kenyan voting public.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained traction due to coverage by multiple independent media outlets and a consistent release of data regarding the upcoming 2027 presidential election.
